name: Akabbo Donations
author: rubypesa

sections.description:
Akabbo Donations adds a configurable donation form to your WordPress site using your Akabbo profile.

This plugin connects to Akabbo, an external software as a service platform for creating donation profiles and processing donor contributions by Mobile Money and Card. Donors submit payment details through the widget, and the plugin sends donation requests to Akabbo’s API so Akabbo can process the payment and return the payment status.

Akabbo Terms of Use: https://akabbo.com/terms-of-use

Privacy Policy: https://rubypesa.com/privacy

The plugin supports:

  • Mobile Money payments for Airtel and MTN in Uganda.
  • Card payments by Visa and Mastercard.
  • Configurable collection currency: USD or UGX.
  • Up to five default donation amounts.
  • Custom primary color for buttons, amount selections, payment method selections, and links.
  • Optional “Powered by Akabbo” credit link.

To use the plugin, open Developer settings for your Akabbo profile, create an app with your website URL, copy its Client ID, and enter it on the Akabbo settings page in WordPress.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the akabbo-donations folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Akabbo in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Enter your Akabbo Client ID.
  5. Choose your currency, default donation amounts, and appearance settings.
  6. Add the shortcode [akabbo_widget] to any page, post, or widget area.
sections.faq:
Where do I get my Akabbo Client ID?

Go to https://akabbo.com, open Developer settings for your profile, create an app with your website URL, then copy its Client ID.

Does this plugin connect to an external service?

Yes. The plugin connects to Akabbo’s API to load donation profile details, submit donation payment requests, load supported countries after a donor selects card payment, and check Mobile Money payment status. Akabbo is required for this plugin to process donations. Akabbo’s Terms of Use are available at https://akabbo.com/terms-of-use, and the privacy policy is available at https://rubypesa.com/privacy.

Which currencies are supported?

The plugin supports USD and UGX. USD is the default.

Which payment methods are supported?

The widget supports Mobile Money and card payments.

Can I change the widget color?

Yes. The Akabbo settings page includes a primary color setting. It defaults to Akabbo blue.

Can I hide the Powered by Akabbo link?

Yes. The public credit link is disabled by default and can be enabled from the Appearance settings.

1.0.3

  • Fixed Mobile Money status checks to use the donation UUID reference.
  • Recognize both SUCCESSFUL and COMPLETED payment statuses.
  • Fixed Mobile Money donations failing when the card country field is empty.
  • Show a clear message when a payment is initiated without a status reference.

1.0

  • Initial release.
